tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sde gzhung sprul sku byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad pa'i sde gzhung sprul sku 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar// oṃ swa sti/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan 'gran zla bral ba sde gzhung mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam/ yongs grags a 'jam rin po che ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa shing mo bya lor/ li thang sde gzhung dpon tshang du 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rigs sad/ gzim 'og mchog sprul byams pa bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyi ye shes kyi bkod pa gcig yin par grags shing grub/ khu bo sprul sku lung rigs nyi ma dang / sde gzhung dar rgyas gling gi mkhan po dge bshes dbang grub dang / 'jam dbyangs snyan grags las gzhung lugs du mar gsan bsam mdzad/ sku nar son nas sde dge lhun grub steng gi yang dben du 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po'i zhal snga nas gsung ngag lam 'bras/ rgyud sde dang / sgrub btus gtsos smin grol rgya mtshos rgyud phyug par mdzad/ ru dam rdzogs chen dgon du mkhan chen gzhan phan chos kyi snang ba'i drung nas gzhung chen bcu gsum/ sdom rigs gnyis/ spyi ljon brtag gsum sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung nyi shu rtsa brgyad la gsan bsam phul phyin gnang bas mkhyen rab kyi klong brdol/ mkhan chen gzhan dga' rin po che'i zhal slob kyi khrod nas/ sa skya'i phyogs nas sde gzhung sprul sku dang / rnying ma'i phyogs nas mi nyag gser mkhar chos grags gnyis mkhyen rab 'gren zla bral zhes gleng / a 'dzoms 'brug pa 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje 'chang las snying thig ya bzhi sogs snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos skor mang du gsan/ gzhan yang phan bde mkhan chen dpal ldan blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdzong gsar mkhyen brtse'i phrin las mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros/ g.yon ru be tshang chos rje mkhas grub rgya mtsho/

sga ston rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun dga' nyi ma/ sde dge pe har bla ma blo gros sogs bshes gnyen du ma las chos bka' mang du gsan/ khyad par 'gran zla kun bral gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma sga ston rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang legs pa rin po che la gsol ba lan mang btab pa sngon 'gros sde gzhung gi sa char snga phyi lan bzhi gdan 'dren zhus te zhabs pad bkod/ don yod rnam pa bzhis mchod pa gya nom pas thugs dgyes par mdzad/ so thar/ byang sems/ rig pa 'dzin pa ste sdom pa gsum gyi bkra drin nos/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras/ mkha' spyod ma/ mgon po phyi nang gsang gsum gyi smin grol gdams pa rje bla ma nyid kyi thugs la mnga' zhing / nyams su bzhes pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan yongs rdzogs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bzhes/ rje bla ma gdul bya skyong slad/ sde dge kre hor/ mi nyag yul rnams gar phebs su yang phebs/ gdan sa thar lam dgon du yang lan du mar byon/ yun ring tsam bzhugs nas/ chos kyi gsung gleng dang / nyams rtogs kyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi thugs kyi sras mchog tu gyur/ sku chung ngu nas/ bla dpon mi chen gyi go sa dang / dkor dang grong chog 'bul sdud la ye nas mi dgyes/ gshin po'i lam ston cho ga 'don pa dang 'pho 'debs la 'gro ba phar bzhag gson po'i rim gro'i rkyen sel sgrol chog tsam 'doms pa 'dra la'ang 'gro ma myong gsung / grwa rkyang nyams chung gi tshul du chos kyi grogs po bla ma blo gros phun tshogs dang lhan du/ mi'i rgyu 'grul med pa'i ri khrod lung stong kho nar bzhugs/ phan tshun 'bod skad go tsam gyi sbra gur chung ngu re phub pa'i nang du chos kyi nyams len la dril/ gsol chas zla ba re bzhin dpon tshang nas skyel/ bla ma blo gros sku gshegs nas/ zhal slob chos mdzad re zung nye 'khor du bzhag nas sku tshe'i smad la rong khog bzhag sa zer ba'i sa cha/

rdo 'jom zer ba'i nags khrod du gzim skyil brgyabs nas zhugs/ ri khrod du sgrub pa la bzhugs skabs/ sngon 'gro bsags sbyong yi dam mang po'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad pa gor ma chags kyang / cha ma 'tshal/ gsang sngags lam gyi rtsa ba lam zab bla ma'i nyams len la chig bsgril gyis/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ /sh+loka 'bum ther bdun cu don lnga dang / rje legs pa rin po che'i gsol 'debs zhal gsung / ngag gi dbang phyug sh+loka gcig po de 'bum phrag drug song bar zhal las thos/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams bzhes dang / theg chen blo sbyong gi nyams len la shin tu 'bad khul yin gsung / rje bla ma legs pa rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ sde gzhung sprul sku a 'jam rin po ches bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su lta ba'i mos gus kyis gsol ba btab pa la brten/ nga'i rgyud la yod pa'i sa skya pa'i lam 'bras kyi go rtogs thams cad spar btab pa bzhin thugs la 'phos 'dug rten 'brel gyi gnad zer ba mtshar po red gsungs/ sprul sku rin po che nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / nga'i bla ma sa skya pa blo gter rje/ legs pa rin po che/ rnying ma ba gzhan dga' rin po che/ a 'dzoms 'brug pa ste 'di rnam pa bzhi ka grub thob red/ yon tan la khyad par med kyang / nga'i rgyud la 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i lta grub thun mong ma yin pa la go ba legs pa zhig chags pa 'di sga ston rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid las byung ba yin pas/ sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba'i mkhas grub kyi/ /bla ma du mas rjes su bzung na yang / /bkra drin gzhan dang mtshungs pa ma mchis pa/ /rje btsun thugs rje'i gter chen khyed lags so/ /zhes zhus pa yin/ bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can shākya thub pa dang bla ma rin po che 'di gnyis la nga rang gis dad pa che chung gi khyad par spu rtse tsam med/ 'on kyang 'u cag gi ston pa shākya mu ne la rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dad pa thun min yongs dka' bas na/

bla ma la'ang de tsam las yong dka' tshad red gsung / gang zag dbang po rab bla ma'i mos gus kyis grol ba zhes pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad bla ma 'di la tshang ba yin 'dug pa rnam thar thams cad kyi snying po der 'dus so/ /lha mo dbyangs can dmar mo'i gsang sgrub ljags bsnyen lan du mar bzhugs nas/ rtags mtshan ngo mtshar ba du ma byung / dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung ba red ces bla ma legs pa rin po che'i gsung las thos/ bstan srung rdo rje gur mgon gyis rjes su bzung ba'i rtags mtshan du mnga' ba dang / rdzong sar mkhyen brtse'i dbang khang nas/ rje bla ma sga ston legs pa rdo rje 'chang gis/ mkhyen brtse'i mchog sprul rin po che dang / sprul sku rin po che 'di nyid sogs snod ldan du mar mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang zhig stsal skabs/ rjes gnang dngos gzhi tshugs nas ye shes dbab skabs/ rje bla mas sprul sku rin po che 'di gur gyi mgon po'i skur dngos su gyur par gzigs zhes thos/ sde gzhung dgon pa 'phan yul nā leṇ+ḍa'i dgon lag tu gtogs pas sger srung rgyal po pe har dang / tsi'u dmar po mchod dgos stabs rgyun gtor gnang mdzad 'dug pas/ gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po 'bral med du 'go zhing / phrin las gang bcol 'phral du sgrub byung ba'i gtam ngo mtshar ba yod/ bla ma legs pa rdo rje 'chang gi bka' nan phebs pa dang / dad slob rnams kyis gsol ba btab ngor/ sku tshe'i smad la gzhung lugs du ma'i 'chad spel dang / dbang gdams ngag kyang du ma stsal zhing / khyad par sga skye rgu dgon gyi mkhan po phrin las chos 'phel nas lo du mar 'bral med du zhabs drung du bzhugs pa la/ bla ma gzhan dga' rin po che las gzhung nyi shu gsan mdzad pa thams cad bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i mchod pa yin/ gsung 'chad nyan rdzogs par gnang grub pa'i skal ba bzang por gyur/ bla ma'i bstod tshogs/

dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa gnyis/ nyams mgur bla ma dran pa'i gdung dbyangs/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi don 'grel/ gsung ngag lam 'bras la bsngags pa/ rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa/ lam dus nyams len go don bdud rtsi'i nying khu/ blo sbyong smon lam/ zhal gdams skor sogs bstan bcos ngo mtshar can 'ga' zhig bzhugs pa snang ba rjes 'jug rnams la bkra drin che/ sde gzhung dgon sder rgyud bskul 'bul ba bsdus nas sga ston rdo rje 'chang gi gdung rten 'dra sku gser zangs las grub pa zhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs pa dang / rje sga ston rdo rje 'chang gis lo bco lnga bcad rgya bzhugs skabs kyi dbu skra bsregs thal las 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi sku 'bum phrag du ma par btab nas nang bzhugs phul ba mchod rten du ma bzhengs pa dang / rgyal bka' rin po ches gtsos gsung rab pusti ka grangs mang bslu mdzad pa sogs rnam dkar mdzad pa rgya cher spel ba dang / dgung grangs drug cu re brgyad chu 'brug lor zhi bar gshegs/ dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul/ gdung rten bzhengs pa sogs rjes kyi bya ba sde gzhung ma'i dpon dang dgon sde nas bsgrubs song // / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi ma/ sde gzhung sprul sku 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
